name: Reference soil Brazil 13
summary: A very deep, intensely weathered Ferralsol from the Amazon near Belterra. Almost nothing weatherable is left: the clay is kaolinite with iron and aluminium oxides, giving a uniform brownish-yellow color, a porous, crumbly structure and very low nutrient reserves.
credit: Photo: ISRIC World Soil Reference Collection, CC BY-SA 3.0 https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:ISRIC_monolith_BR-013.jpg — Site and horizon data condensed from ISRIC – World Soil Information https://isis.isric.org/monoliths/reference-soil-br013 — Feature notes written for this site.

horizons.name: Ah
horizons.description: Brown (10YR 5/3 moist) clay; weak to moderate very fine and fine subangular blocky to crumb structure; friable; clear smooth boundary.

horizons.name: AB
horizons.description: Yellowish brown (10YR 5/4 moist) clay; weak subangular blocky to porous massive structure; friable; gradual smooth boundary. (Designation assigned here.)

horizons.name: BA
horizons.description: Brownish yellow (10YR 6/6 moist) clay; weak fine and medium subangular blocky to porous massive structure; firm; diffuse smooth boundary.

horizons.name: Bw1
horizons.description: Brownish yellow (10YR 6/8 moist) clay; weak fine and medium subangular blocky structure; firm; broken thin clay cutans; ferralic; diffuse smooth boundary.

horizons.name: Bw2
horizons.description: Brownish yellow (10YR 6/8 moist) clay; porous massive; firm; broken thin clay cutans; ferralic; continues to at least 250 cm.

features.title: Leaf litter
features.description: Thin forest litter. Nutrients cycle quickly between litter and roots because the mineral soil holds very few.

features.title: Root
features.description: Most roots stay in the upper soil, where nearly all the nutrients are.

features.title: Humus mottling
features.description: Faint darker patches where organic matter from the surface has been worked into the yellow clay.

features.title: Porous massive structure
features.description: Very fine micro-aggregates of clay bound by iron and aluminium oxides make the soil look massive, but it drains like a sand.

features.title: Round channel
features.description: Circular channel, probably an old root or ant gallery.

features.title: Infilled burrow (krotovina)
features.description: An old animal burrow, later filled with soil from above.
